items.english: (To prove) the validity of this expression also for the case not considered in the derivation, when between ... the functions p and q take the same value several times.

items.quote: Wenn das Gebiet, in welchem die Lufttheilchen in relativer Bewegung begriffen sind,
items.english: If the region in which the air particles are in relative motion is initially confined to values of x between x1 and x2, it splits after a finite time into two waves travelling in opposite directions: in one p is constant and q varies, in the other the reverse.
